description: AI-native BuildOS for Codex, Claude Code and Doubao: product discovery, UI/UX design, software engineering, context-aware workflows, testing, Git and verifiable releases.

summary.zh: 优先治理缺陷生产源，并用单一版本清单防止多需求协作在发布时漏项。
summary.en: Fix defect sources before symptoms and use one version list to prevent release omissions across queued work.
summary.ja: 症状より欠陥の発生源を優先し、単一のバージョンリストで複数作業のリリース漏れを防止。
